trades.thesis: Everpure (ex-Pure Storage) Q3 FY27 blowout: revenue $1.459B +51% vs ~$1.33B consensus, non-GAAP op income $345M vs $265-275M guide, FY27 revenue guide raised to $5.20-5.21B (from $5.03-5.07B) and op income to $1.08-1.09B (from $940-960M), Q4 guide above consensus, RPO +44%, hyperscale ramp. Stock was 36% below its October high after four down days into the print, so positioning was washed out. Risks: gross margin 68% with price cuts, FY28 outlook unchanged, +7% gap, 6% daily vol, AI-tape reversal after Anthropic debut.
